integrity: All general statements are analytically proved; finite exact-rational computations are corroborative only. Independent evaluation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic one-state lake phosphorus toy model with independently parametrized, instantaneous quadratic Hill recycling fluxes. The constructed coefficients are not calibrated to field data, and no management claims follow. Historical equivalence cannot be exhaustively excluded.
title: Sharp multistability bounds for parallel quadratic phosphorus recycling
